description: This file defines the `Zend_Json_Encoder` class responsible for encoding PHP data structures into JSON format within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for encoding objects, arrays, and basic data types, as well as functionality for handling class reflection and serialization details.

classes.name: Zend_Json_Encoder
classes.description: A class providing methods to encode PHP data types and class reflection info into JSON strings, with support for object cycle checks and class reflection.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a PHP value into a JSON string, with optional cycle checking.

methods.name: _encodeValue
methods.description: Recursively encodes a value based on its type (object, array, or datum).

methods.name: _encodeObject
methods.description: Encodes a PHP object into a JSON object, with optional cycle detection.

methods.name: _wasVisited
methods.description: Checks if an object has been visited during cycle detection to prevent infinite recursion.

methods.name: _encodeArray
methods.description: Encodes a PHP array into a JSON array or object depending on whether it is associative.

methods.name: _encodeDatum
methods.description: Encodes a basic PHP data type (string, number, boolean, null) into a JSON representation.

methods.name: _encodeString
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string and encodes it for JSON.

methods.name: _encodeConstants
methods.description: Encodes the constants of a ReflectionClass into a JSON format.

methods.name: _encodeMethods
methods.description: Encodes the public, user-defined methods of a ReflectionClass into a string.

methods.name: _encodeVariables
methods.description: Encodes the public properties of a ReflectionClass into a JSON object.

methods.name: encodeClass
methods.description: Encodes a class into a JavaScript class2 format using reflection.

methods.name: encodeClasses
methods.description: Encodes multiple classes into a combined JavaScript class2 format.
